learning_outcomes.text: Knows basic electrical and magnetic knowledge and laws.
Explains the structure, operating principle, and applications of transformers and dynamos.
Explains the structure, operating principle, and different connection types of DC motors.
Knows the structure, operating principle, characteristics, and applications of asynchronous and synchronous machines.
Classifies the characteristics of work machines.
Lists motor selection criteria and distinguishes operating conditions.

syllabus_topics: Introduction and basic laws (Kirchoff's Law, Ohm's Law)
Basic Laws (Ampere's Law, Faraday's Law, Lenz's Law)
Right-hand rules and their application to electrical machines
DC machines and application of basic laws
Starting and speed control in DC machines
Asynchronous machines and application of basic laws
Synchronous machines and application of basic laws
assessment_rules: Midterm Exam, Quiz 1, and Quiz 2 contribute to 100% of the 'Yarıyıl Çalışmaları' (Semester Studies) grade. The final grade is calculated as 60% from the Final Exam and 40% from the 'Yıl İçinin Başarıya' (In-year performance) grade.
